title: Blueberry, Oat and Greek Yogurt Smoothie
excerpt: A creamy, filling shake, ready in 5 minutes, with the intense color and flavor of high-mountain blueberries.
imageAlt: Glass of purple blueberry smoothie with Greek yogurt and oats, decorated with fresh blueberries and rolled oats

ingredients.text: 1 cup (150 g) Fresh Pick blueberries, fresh or frozen
1 cup (240 ml) milk or plant-based drink
4 ice cubes (omit if using frozen blueberries)

steps: Put the milk and yogurt in the blender first; that way the blades spin easily.
Add the oats, blueberries, honey and ice. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Blend on high speed for 45–60 seconds, until no bits of oats remain.
Taste and adjust: more milk if you want it thinner, more honey if you prefer it sweeter.
Serve immediately and decorate with a few whole blueberries.
tips: Freeze your Fresh Pick blueberries on a tray and then move them to a bag: the smoothie turns out thicker and colder without watering it down with ice.
If you soak the oats in the milk for 10 minutes before blending, the texture is silkier.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
